comment: NxEterna card packs. Odds are percent per slot; the last slot of each pack is the chase slot. Weights are relative inside their list. Checked against work/quests/registry.json by work/gacha-design/build_pools.py. Entries marked pending are relics from design/gacha/relics.json: their ids do not exist until the relic mod ships and are skipped until then. Generated by tools/packs-mod/make_config.py from design/gacha/pools.json; relic entries carry their pull line in 'line'.

rules.fallback_category: used only when every other category of that rarity has no resolvable entry
rules.announce_levels: none | chat (one chat line) | server (chat, toast, bell, Chronicle) | everyone (server + fanfare for all)

entries.label: Grudgebrand
entries.line: It remembers what killed you. It has not forgiven.

entries.label: The Good Ear
entries.line: A large ear. Press it to the rock. It hears ore. It hears everything.

entries.label: Moonshare Sickle
entries.line: Reaps a field in one sweep. The moon takes a cut, and tips well.

entries.label: Nimby
entries.line: A small personal raincloud. It is not sad. It is working.

entries.label: Roll Call
entries.line: Every pet you own, here, now, and pleased about it.

entries.label: Hopalong
entries.line: A hobby-horse pogo stick. Each bounce goes higher. So does the fall.

entries.label: The Skipper
entries.line: A stone that gets angrier every time it bounces.

entries.label: Fistful of Balloons
entries.line: Ties a balloon to anything. Anything.

entries.label: One-Way Ticket
entries.line: Up is solved. Down is your problem.

entries.label: Second Opinion
entries.line: Every swing happens twice. The second one is late.

entries.label: The Gulp
entries.line: A glove with a mouth in the palm. Return to sender.

entries.label: A Handful of Eyes
entries.line: Scatter them. They roll underfoot. They watch whoever falls.

entries.label: Inconspicuous Rock
entries.line: Become a rock. Mobs do not suspect the rock.

entries.label: Rainy Day Pig
entries.line: Saves a fifth of every experience point you earn. Smash in emergencies.

entries.label: The Colony
entries.line: Something is growing on you. It is friendly. It is spreading.

entries.label: The Big Sneeze
entries.line: A pinch of snuff. Bless you. Bless everyone in front of you.

entries.label: The Crumb Trail
entries.line: Leaves a trail only your party can see. Follow it home.

entries.label: The Kingpin
entries.line: Hit one monster into the others. Strike!

entries.label: Wickling
entries.line: A small flame that follows you and worries about the dark.

entries.label: The Scrap Maw
entries.line: A purse with teeth. Feed it your rubbish. It gives back what it could not keep down.

entries.label: The Lick
entries.line: A tongue in a jar. It reaches twelve blocks. It is always wet.

entries.label: The Metronome
entries.line: A blade that keeps time. Hit on the beat or don't bother.

entries.label: The Doorknob
entries.line: Any wall is a door if you're rude enough.

entries.label: Trading Places
entries.line: Swap places with whatever you're looking at. It does not get a vote.

entries.label: The Pushy Barometer
entries.line: Tap the glass. The sky does as it's told.

entries.label: Moonswing
entries.line: A small moon on a chain. Hold to swing. Mind your friends' heads.

entries.label: Bottled Tantrum
entries.line: There is a very small, very angry wind in here.

entries.label: Storm Warning
entries.line: Throw it. Count to two. Don't stand there.

entries.label: Strawman
entries.line: Monsters will not spawn where he can see. He can see sixteen blocks.

entries.label: Mime's Gloves
entries.line: There's a wall here. No, really. Ask the zombie.

entries.label: Thick & Thin
entries.line: Two bracelets. What hurts one hurts both. Half each.

entries.label: The Long Way Down
entries.line: A sled that works on everything except flat ground.

entries.label: The Clingy Worm
entries.line: A very long, very stretchy worm. It bites the wall. It will not let go of you either.

entries.label: Lookout Frog
entries.line: A frog sits on your head. It eats arrows. It has opinions about what's behind you.

entries.label: The Attentive Gnome
entries.line: Tends your garden. Only moves when nobody is looking. He is closer than he was.

entries.label: The Hot Potato
entries.line: Pass it on. Do not be holding it when it goes off.

entries.label: The Tall Tale
entries.line: Become enormous for 45 seconds. Mind the doorframes.

entries.label: The Small Hours
entries.line: Hold to wind the sky. Everyone watches the sun move.

entries.label: Leap of Faith
entries.line: Walk on nothing. It holds for ten seconds. Probably.

entries.label: Thousandfold
entries.line: A flock of paper cranes with a grudge.
